infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: Ticket Frame saves only the ticket frames and match-memory photos you explicitly choose to export.

plugins.photosPermission: Ticket Frame needs access to ticket screenshots you choose and match-day photos you privately save in Match Memories.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Ticket Frame uses your location for live nearby Apple Maps results, stadium attendance and private photo-location grouping.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Ticket Frame uses low-power stadium geofences around favourite-team match times so it can ask whether you attended.

plugins.photosPermission: Ticket Frame reads the date and location of authorised match-day photos to group them privately and suggest nearby places with Apple Maps.
plugins.savePhotosPermission: Ticket Frame can save photos you choose for match memories.
